references.text: Earlier gathering of the inhabitants of Shechem at the fortress, illustrating the pattern of people assembling at this fortified place
The preceding verse describing how the inhabitants of Shechem's tower sought refuge, which led to Abimelech being informed
The consequence of this assembly—Abimelech burned the tower with everyone inside it
Another tower in the region of Shechem that was destroyed, the tower of Peniel, showing Gideon's family's connection to fortified structures in the area
Earlier violent history in Shechem involving Jacob's sons, highlighting the city's turbulent past
